'''S-04-18''' was a restricted security file that contained reports from medical staff indicating that the release of a toxic gas by a a malfunctioning environmental control unit in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] was highly unlikely, and expressed concern that it had been generated by chance.
